| [SYNTHESIS-062](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-062.md) | A frame acts on an interpreter, and an interpreter's judgements act back on what it observes: order dependence among framing operations shows that the operations do not commute, not that the probability is nonclassical; conditioning on a situation, changing it, telling an interpreter about it and eliciting a judgement are different operations, and only changing the situation intervenes on what would constitute an act; a judgement reshapes the observer whose later observations it judges, objected to as action relocated and as a loop that confirms itself, and what keeps that loop honest is evidence that does not pass through the interpretation it tests, a condition the record carries over to when a category's success warrants a kind, beside an account of how a contested label can be reproduced by rival use while whether it carries one concept stays open | A part account of the pragmatic-transport line: the part on frames as operations on an interpreter's state, on what an intervention on an interpreter can show, and on the loop in which judgement reshapes the observer, with the condition on evidence the record draws from that loop and carries to categories, beside the contested label the record files as its case. | [SYNTHESIS-068](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-068.md) | A communicative kind is a repeatable relational organization that distinct events realize, proposed as partly constituted by relations to roles, norms and expected uptake and recognized through probes that fix it only relative to the family used: identification underdetermines constitution, a character or other invariant classifies kinds only up to isomorphism and only once a symmetry is anchored on the situation, competent uptake is offered as a defeasible standard against which probe families are tested, sharing a kind is neither transport nor descent, and the constitution claim stays open against intention-based accounts, the change of audience a translation makes, and the individuation of tokens |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-069](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-069.md) | A communicative object is a context-indexed system of empirical constraints whose global realizability is to be found out, not assumed: where it fails, the obstruction lies in the supports or distributions, not in the event sheaf, in contexts that do not overlap or in frames whose correspondence is fixed, and it is neither ordinary context dependence nor ambiguity; within a fixed scenario the headline that translation keeps local meanings while changing global structure has only constructed cases, since the behavioural data read show no contextuality proper, and it is carried forward as a change in which questions readers can decide, whose standing as a change of cover is disputed; translation operations form a semigroup of directed lossy maps whose invertible core is the relabellings; whether communicative categories form a concept lattice is open; and many of the line's defeat conditions cannot be met by any study |  | Proposed |
